topic_title: Traffic Control Devices: Legal Foundation & Enforcement
prompt: What is the Texas legal status regarding automated red-light photographic enforcement cameras?

options.text: Prohibited statewide under Texas House Bill 1631 with very rare grandfathered exceptions
Mandatory at every signalized intersection across all Texas municipal cities
Permitted only on state freeways during peak afternoon rush hour periods
Operated exclusively by private insurance companies to set policy rates
